Use case: ads-marketing.
Create a NEW single landscape software project banner in standard 16:9 format, exactly the same output resolution as the other banners in this series (1672 x 941 pixels). Full-bleed opaque background, no border.
Project: Chat Laetus, a conversational AI API and web client supporting text and image questions.
An elegant editorial illustration on deep forest-green paper-textured background. Two large overlapping mint and lavender speech bubbles with three dots, one small ivory-framed landscape picture symbol, and a single flowing mint/lavender conversation thread. These three simple symbolic objects are the ENTIRE scene. No people, faces, animals, flowers, plants, robot mascots, buildings, desks, UI screens, code or badges. Calm thoughtful software identity.
Large beautifully typeset ivory title in a refined serif face, exactly: "Chat Laetus". Keep text and important symbols 7% inside the edges. Use a spacious balanced layout with the large title in the upper third and the speech and image symbols below it. Subtle tactile paper texture, clear shapes, readable at small thumbnail size. No other text, subtitle, dates, watermark or labels.

Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: finished banner for a software project's GitHub README and portfolio.
Create one single landscape banner, EXACTLY 1536 x 864 pixels, aspect ratio 16:9, opaque full-bleed background. This is one member of a coherent five-banner collection: elegant editorial illustration, restrained depth and subtle paper texture, generous breathing room, a large highly legible project title integrated into the composition, and one clear project-specific illustration. Do not show a web browser, fake dashboard, application screenshot, code, technology badges, performance claims, dates, watermarks, or extra labels. Sky blue and ivory palette inspired by the original project's light-blue UI. Intelligent, fresh, organized and friendly, with a refined editorial illustration and subtle depth, no fake interface.
Text (verbatim): "UNINOTE"
Only that title, no subtitle.
